شللت (form I)
# شَلِلْتُ (šaliltu) /ʃa.lil.tu/: first-person singular past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلِلْتَ (šalilta) /ʃa.lil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلِلْتِ (šalilti) /ʃa.lil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلَلْتُ (šalaltu) /ʃa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلَلْتَ (šalalta) /ʃa.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
